The company receives part of its construction orders from Tokyu Construction Co., Ltd. and Tokyu Corporation, which are other affiliated companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥74,658 million.

entries.357ffd31d48674de: A business that manufactures and sells paving materials, including asphalt mixtures. The company, its consolidated subsidiaries Shinseiki Kogyo Co., Ltd., General Act Co., Ltd. and SEIKITOKYU MYANMAR ROAD COMPANY LIMITED, and its affiliate Noto Ascon Co., Ltd. operate this business. They purchase part of the paving materials and raw materials manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries and others, and the company also sells part of its products to Shinseiki Kogyo Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,467 million.
entries.45851c3bbb695360: Across its nationwide branch network, the company has bases for both the construction business and the paving materials manufacturing and sales business, and has put in place a structure in which it operates asphalt mixture plants in-house while carrying out paving works. In Tochigi Prefecture it has a technical research institute and an equipment center, which conduct research and development of new technologies and construction methods, testing and experiments on various materials, and maintenance, modification and management of construction machinery and equipment. Major completed works for the current consolidated fiscal year include expressway paving works ordered by East Nippon Expressway Company Limited, Central Nippon Expressway Company Limited, West Nippon Expressway Company Limited and others.
entries.4b1c7b8d9434fef9: Its main customers are government agencies such as the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism and local public bodies, expressway companies and private-sector companies.
entries.54d38cff0760d191: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95,259 million, down 4.1% year on year. By segment, the Construction Business was ¥74,658 million, the Paving Materials Manufacturing and Sales Business was ¥20,467 million, and other was ¥133 million.
entries.56ec3846fe736011: The company positions itself as 'a lifeline-creating company contributing to building rich local communities,' and its long-term vision, 'Ideal State in 2030,' sets out 'a truly resilient corporate group that contributes to realizing a sustainable society by reconciling the growth of people and the growth of the company.' Currently, under the medium-term management plan for fiscal 2024–2026, which is its 2nd phase, the company is advancing measures based on the basic policies of expanding stable earnings, diversifying revenue sources, practicing management centered on people, establishing new ways of working, and strengthening its management and financial foundations.
